fusions.name: Grows on the Wound
fusions.desc: Spits at the first enemy in its path up to 5 tiles away, dealing 4 damage. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction the target carries (max 40%).

fusions.name: Brood Cloud
fusions.desc: Sacrifices 4% of your maximum health to bud off a cloud of stinging spawn, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Tide Pool
fusions.desc: Fills a tide pool reaching 3.5 tiles around where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Accretion
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
